mostWorthwhile.text: Building living supporting tissue was most worthwhile: the sequence connected collagen production and secretion to a tissue made of both cells and extracellular matrix.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final muscle-protein step felt somewhat repetitive after the collagen branch, although it reinforced how different messages use the same building blocks.

surprise.text: The supporting tissue required a separate combination of fibroblasts and matrix even though the matrix result already showed living fibroblasts beside it.

arbitrary.text: Combining the fibroblasts with their own newly produced matrix felt slightly artificial as a separate action, though its purpose was clear.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: the constructions make the relationship between gene expression, cells and tissue concrete, and the unfinished muscle-development path invites further exploration.
